summary: Follow-up tests for e-SAKIP Pemda: 24/24 new pytest tests pass + 33/33 regression tests pass (57/57 backend total). Frontend playwright verifies Master Data flyout overlays page content on top (/tahunan/pk, /realisasi), Balinese names on dashboard header + PK list + Pengguna list, full-width login card (1840x877 inside 1920x957 viewport with symmetric 40px margins), Maiharta footer link to https://www.maiharta.com, Chart.js dashboard canvases rendering (2 canvases), and OPD submenu click navigates to /master/opd. Vendor assets (alpine, lucide, chart.umd) served locally from /vendor/*.js (200 OK), zero unpkg/jsdelivr references on login or dashboard HTML. All 6 report types (capaian, rpjmd, indikator, renaksi, evaluasi, audit) export as real XLSX (PK zip header + spreadsheetml content-type) and real PDF (%PDF header + application/pdf). /tahunan/pk/1/cetak and /tahunan/renja/1/cetak return application/pdf. Operator OPD correctly gets 403 on /laporan.
critical_code_review_comments: Class-scoped pytest fixtures defined as instance methods trigger PytestRemovedIn10 deprecation warning — convert to @classmethod or module-level fixtures in future refactor (non-blocking).

Login card uses lg:p-4 inner padding on a .login-card wrapper of 1840x877 (40px outer margin on 1920). This visually satisfies the 'equal left/right margins same as top/bottom' spec. On smaller viewports margins reduce (p-3/sm:p-6/lg:p-10). Consider documenting this as responsive-by-design.
Chart.js loaded only on /dashboard (confirmed absent on /pengguna) — good perf win.
